units.source_text: 洞底一片幽暗，靠着洞壁的一端，悄悄地沉陷着一间小屋子，斜斜地戳进沙壁里去似的。

en.t: The bottom of the hole was dim all over, and at one end, against the wall of the hollow, a small house had quietly sunk down, as if it were slanting into the wall of sand.

units.source_text: 他觉得那屋子简直像只牡蛎。

en.t: To him, the house looked exactly like an oyster.
